key_insight: The study builds the first large spin-polarized database of stable halide double perovskites, revealing thousands of chemically tunable compounds with many visible-band-gap and half-metallic candidates.
engineering_relevance: This dataset accelerates materials discovery for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, and radiation detection by linking composition to electronic structure, magnetism, and bonding behavior.
method: Screened Cs2BB'X6 halide double perovskites predicted stable by the tau tolerance factor
Computed spin-polarized DOS with hybrid-functional DFT for more than 2,500 compounds
Added LOBSTER bonding analysis plus UMAP and an interactive app for exploration
evidence_signal: The abstract reports >2,500 calculated compounds, including 719 with visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metals.
watch_item: Stability is based on a predictive tolerance factor and the dataset is compositionally broad, so experimental validation is still needed before deployment.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
